title: Nanopore Rapid Barcoding Kit Automation Protocol
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Gather equipment and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons P300‑single channel GEN2 pipette, Opentrons P20‑single channel GEN2 pipette, Opentrons 20 µL filter tips, Opentrons 200 µL filter tips, Rapid Barcoding Kit (SQK‑RBK004), fresh 70 % ethanol, water, and 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Load reagents onto temperature deck
steps.instruction: Place the temperature‑deck tube rack and load tubes as follows: put the Rapid Barcoding Kit (RAP) into tube A1, add ~150 µL of AMPure beads to tube A2, and distribute the fragmentation mixes (one per sample, up to 12) into tubes B1 through C6 in ascending order (B1, B2, B3, …).

substeps.instruction: Add ~150 µL AMPure beads to tube A2.
Add each fragmentation mix to tubes B1‑C6 in ascending order, matching the number of samples.

steps.title: Load tubes and add reagents
steps.instruction: Load the tube rack on the deck and add the following liquids: ~500 µL water to tube A1, ~600 µL fresh 70 % ethanol to tube A2, and Tris‑HCl with NaCl to tube A3 (volume as supplied). Place empty tubes in B2 and B3 for liquid trash and intermediate handling, and place an empty tube in C1 to serve as the output tube.

substeps.instruction: Load the tube rack onto the deck.
Add ~500 µL water to tube A1.
Add ~600 µL fresh 70 % ethanol to tube A2.
Add Tris‑HCl with NaCl to tube A3.
Place empty tubes in B2 and B3 (trash and intermediate).
Place an empty tube in C1 (output).

steps.title: Start run and collect library
steps.instruction: Load any remaining deck modules as required by the protocol, then press “Go” on the Opentrons software. No further intervention is needed; after the run completes, retrieve the pooled library from tube C1 in the tube rack.

substeps.instruction: Load the remaining deck components as prompted.
Press “Go” to start the automated protocol.
When the run finishes, remove tube C1 containing the prepared library.
